get.description: SSE event name is magi; each data field is a GatewayEvent JSON envelope and id matches event_id. Retains at most 256 events / 8 MiB in memory. Missing, unknown, old, or different-epoch cursors yield resync_required: reload authoritative snapshots. These hints are not durable business messages. Epoch changes on process restart or reset; data_epoch in maintenance status is a separate mutation scope. Store the cursor only after handling a frame. Renew authentication then reconnect with bounded backoff/jitter; token expiry or revocation ends the stream. A lagging subscriber receives resync_required and is disconnected. Keep-alive comments occur every 15 seconds; capacity is 64 subscribers, excess requests return 429. Product events carry contract_version 1 and follow ProductEvent. No raw runtime notification wrapper is exposed on the product stream. Each scope has an independent epoch, sequence, retention buffer and subscriber limit.

parameters.description: Last processed SSE id, formatted as epoch:sequence.
